moments.text: Phone video through the cockpit canopy: canopy frame upper right, horizon across the middle, part of the jet's grey body lower left. Two small bright spots stay fixed on the glass.
The camera swings up past the canopy frame to open sky above the horizon.
A small round light-grey object streaks from the left edge to right of centre, rising slightly. Only 3 frames (~0.1 s): use frame step.
The camera swings back down; a canopy frame and cockpit interior come into view as the clip ends.
